'''Quellor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
Quellor was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] near [[Churr]], a minor [[Agriworld/Legends|farming]] world.<ref name="FDCR">{{FFG|story=Lessons from the Past|book=Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|text=''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook}}</ref>

==History==
===Old Republic era===
Quellor joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] early in its history, sometime between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Quellor system/Legends|Quellor system]] was [[Battle of the Quellor system (Mandalorian Wars)|attacked]] by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]], as part of the [[Mandalorian Triumph]] campaign.<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] did not secede during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Galactic Civil War===
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Toggan]] was the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of Quellor.<ref name="RESb" />

Sometime between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] went on a [[Mission to Quellor|mission]] to Quellor.<ref name="CS" />

In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Quellor became the site of peaceful, anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rallies.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> At one such rally in [[Terrina Square]], Moff Toggan called up a [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to watch over the crowd and maintain order. Though Moff Toggan specifically ordered his troops to hold their fire unless ordered otherwise, the stormtroopers [[Massacre at Terrina Square|opened fire]] on the protesters when they burned an effigy of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="RESb" />

By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Quellor had become an Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. It was still under Imperial control in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces fleeing the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Gyndine|invasion]] of [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] retreated to Quellor. The Yuuzhan Vong would later [[Battle of the Quellor system (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attack]] and capture the planet itself.<ref name="TEA" />
